questions.stem: A 28-year-old man underwent open reduction and internal fixation of a closed, displaced, intra-articular calcaneal fracture 8 weeks ago. Examination reveals that the lateral EDGEwound is red and draining purulent material. The culture obtained from the wound was found to be Staphylococcus aureus. Radiographs show early healing of the fracture. What is the most appropriate next step in management?

options.label: B
options.text: Débridement of the wound without hardware removal

options.label: C
options.text: Débridement of the wound with hardware removal

options.label: D
options.text: Vacuum-assisted closure (VAC) and negative pressure therapy
